Initial public-release compliance baseline. Full review and sign-off of every control in docs/legal/control-register.json (control-1 .. control-31) by the accountable signatories (cameron-young, an Australian legal practitioner, with tara-buckley co-signing two-person records). The standing legal positions of record: (1) PRINTED ELECTORAL OUTPUT — the National Digital authoriser model for the printed how-to-vote worksheet (s321D Commonwealth Electoral Act): National Digital authorises the fixed printed template and comparison content, and the printed output separately identifies the preference order as the user's own selection; shared links are read-only and cannot print. (2) NEUTRALITY — no candidate or party recommendation anywhere; alignment figures are party-panel-only, derived from recorded parliamentary voting, never attributed to an individual candidate; the enforceable absolute-claims register bans categorical/quasi-legal wording without current evidence-backed permits. (3) FUNDING & DISCLOSURE — National Digital is not a disclosure entity for 2026-H2 (classified electoral expenditure below the $17,300 threshold); to be re-assessed before the 2027-01-01 regime ($5,000 threshold). (4) PRIVACY — voluntary APP-level controls; research storage is aggregate counters only with server-enforced consent, k-threshold (k=10) database-layer disclosure control and complementary suppression; the earlier per-person research data was de-identified to aggregates and destroyed (EV-AGGREGATE-CONVERSION / EV-DESTRUCTION-CERT). (5) DATA RIGHTS — AEC candidate/results CSV data under CC BY 4.0; AEC boundary GIS under the separate AEC Spatial Data Download Data Licence with the prescribed derivative-product notice displayed adjacent to every map; TVFY vote data under ODbL from locked direct-API snapshots; rights domains contamination-proofed. (6) ACCESSIBILITY — WCAG 2.2 AA target with blocking automated gates and completed human assistive-technology testing. (7) ELIGIBILITY — age-first self-declaration gate with an under-18 explore-only mode. For the public release the registers were consolidated and renumbered (controls foundation-first as control-1..control-31; ADRs foundation-first as 0001..0016), superseding the pre-release internal review iterations this baseline consolidates.
